note: No Instagram account connected. Trends are what is currently popular in these three domains, not a platform-wide census.
source: public Instagram trend discovery (social.search, platform=instagram, ranked by engagement)

trends.details: A 55K-like carousel presents a polished fashion editorial starring Elsa Hosk — a hotel suite opener in hair rollers and a fur-collared robe, then a herringbone vest over a white shirt, new black Phoebe Philo bow flats, a long brown fur coat, a turquoise Hermès Birkin paired with sculptural purple Dries Van Noten heels, a long camel trench in front of a pink building, and a strapless grey evening gown with a high slit. A 33K-like carousel shoots an autumn park lookbook — an oversized brown herringbone coat with a dark collar, blue straight-leg jeans, bright red crew socks, black loafers and a black Birkin-style bag with panther-head rings, plus a black cold-shoulder turtleneck slide. A 26K-like carousel documents an upscale holiday event by a blue, gold and silver Christmas tree — a crystal-embellished black blazer mini dress, studded pillbox hat, sheer black tights, pointed heels and a black-and-white checkered Chanel spherical handbag. A 17K-like reel answers 'just wear something casual!' with 'nah' and four glamorous looks — a black satin top with a sheer black sequined maxi skirt, a bright red blazer-style mini dress with black lace tights and a gold beaded clutch, a black sequined turtleneck mini dress, and a black blazer dress with satin lapels and a gold box bag. A 15K-like reel builds a 'trust the process' holiday outfit — a silver sequin maxi skirt with a light-blue snowflake sweater, silver pointed-toe pumps over brown ones, and a metallic silver clutch. A 10K-like carousel styles a camel bouclé coat over a brown ribbed zip-up top and matching trousers, with cream cap-toe flats and a small white structured handbag.
trends.title: Holiday party glam takes over — sequins, red blazer dresses and silver skirts

trends.details: A 130K-like reel tours an elaborately decorated home for Christmas — green garlands strung across doorways with warm white lights, pink ribbons and ornaments, a light green dining table with pink chairs, a large white tree with multicolored LED lights beside a smaller bright pink tree, and a detailed miniature Christmas village on a cabinet beneath the staircase, all set to a playful voiceover. A 92K-like reel presents 'Christmas at the Townhouse' — a red-brick townhouse in snowfall with green wreaths and large red bows in every window, garlands framing the front door, snow-covered topiaries, and a living room tree with white lights and red, gold and clear ornaments including mushroom shapes, a white sofa, a greenery-draped mantel with stockings, and a small white dog wandering through. A 35K-like reel builds an elaborate at-home Christmas date night — a ceiling fan wrapped in oversized red and green bulbs and garland, a gray sectional dressed with a red plaid blanket, a 'Hot Cocoa Bar' console table with artificial snow and fairy lights, a chocolate fountain, popcorn and pretzels, and a lit fireplace for watching 'A Christmas Story.' A 31K-like reel answers 'My husband said two tree was too much...' with 'I disagree' — two full trees with red ornaments and ribbons in a bedroom with coffered ceilings, a crystal chandelier and a marble fireplace, glowing at night in the gold-framed mirror. An 18K-like reel recreates an '80s Christmas Kitchen' — shiny multicolor tinsel garlands, strings of baubles and large white paper star lanterns draped along cabinets, ceilings and doorways, with green garland framing the sink window. A 9.6K-like reel gives a nighttime living room update — a huge tree with multicolor lights between pink striped curtains, C9 garlands running around the whole room, a dark green sofa, and a dining table set with a plaid runner, miniature trees, deer figurines, gingerbread houses and fairy lights.
trends.title: Maximalist Christmas goes pink — garlands, two trees and a townhouse in the snow

trends.details: A 160K-like tutorial lets 'CHRISTMAS FILTERS CHOOSE MY MAKEUP' — a reindeer-antler headband, an AR filter dictating the look: yellow stars on the cheeks, green eyeshadow, snowman graphics by the outer eyes, lips painted half red and half green, white glittery brows and candy-cane patterns. A 48K-like reel declares 'christmas time is for glittery makeup' — black winged liner and finger-applied blush, then a reveal: blonde hair with bangs, glittery eyeshadow, false lashes and glossy lips with a black top and red plaid scarf. A 25K-like tutorial builds a vibrant purple eye — dark purple liquid liner wing, matte light purple in the crease, shimmery metallic purple and pink from a Natasha Denona palette ('concord', 'flutter'), lined lower lash line and a concealer cleanup. A 21K-like tutorial (Part 1) demos a brown, glittery, hooded-eye friendly smoky eye — concealer primer, the ColourPop 'Gone Matte' palette (shade 'Rab'), keeping the brow bone lighter and blending above the natural crease. A 20K-like reel shows a '5 minute ski girl makeup' in front of snow-covered mountains — L'Oreal Revitalift serum, a playful snow 'wash', Supergoop sunscreen, Maybelline Grippy Serum primer, Armani Luminous Silk foundation, NARS concealer, YSL blush, Fenty highlighter, Benefit Badgal Bang mascara and Dior lip gloss. A 15K-like tutorial asks 'is it too early for some Christmas makeup...?' — concealer, powder and blush, faux freckles dotted across the nose and cheeks, black waterline liner, mascara, and dark red lip liner topped with glossy red liquid lipstick.
trends.title: Christmas filters pick the makeup — green eyes, glitter and glossy red lips
